text:
Tess (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're rolling out a handbook update next Monday for 'Work location & Stipend' policy. Main changes: remote stipend caps adjusted, clearer guidance on desk vs stipend reimbursement, and removal of mandated core hours. Please skim and flag any blockers. :loudspeaker:

Devin (Payroll): Is this going to affect April payroll runs? Need lead time for payroll system mapping.

Tess (People Ops): Payroll impact limited to stipend cap values — we'll push a CSV export and a mapping. Targeting no change to payment cadence. Everyone still gets paid on the regular schedule.

Sara (People Ops Ops): We'll require a 5-minute micro-cert for all employees and a 10-minute manager checklist. Completion required by Apr 10. Can we automate reminders?

hr-bot: Weekly digest will post completion rates to #people-ops every Monday at 09:00 PT starting next week. Use command `/hr-bot export-completions --since 2026-04-01 --format csv`.

Irina (EMEA Ops): EU contractors have a different stipend rule set — need localized guidance and legal sign-off. Also VAT/tax treatment differs by country.

Jamal (Comp): Confirmed — comp will publish a localized table for EU + UK by EOD tomorrow. I'll include a tax treatment note and a short FAQ entry.

Sophie (People Ops): Translation team asked for a week to localize the handbook snippets. Can we hold the global publish for translations?

Tess (People Ops): Prefer not to block the global publish. Plan: publish the master update + region-specific addenda as soon as ready. We'll clearly label "localized addendum coming" for affected regions.

Devin (Payroll): For tracking, I need a CSV with these headers. Will the export include historical versions?

Tess (People Ops): Yes — we'll include ack_version per row so you can filter by the handbook revision. Example header below.

```
# payroll_export.csv header
employee_id, name, email, region, role, stipend_amount, completion_status, completion_ts, ack_version
```

Sara (People Ops Ops): I'll set up a manager dashboard filter (by team, region) so managers can see team completion in real time. Filing a JIRA for analytics & dashboard work now.

Jamal (Comp): Also adding a note to compensation approval flows: reimbursements require receipts; stipends do not. Need to call that out explicitly.

Irina (EMEA Ops): Can we add a short line for contractors: "Contractors: refer to your contract or contact ops@redwood.com" — avoids overpromising.

Tess (People Ops): Done. Will add that copy to the handbook and to the micro-cert preamble.

Sophie (People Ops): Who is owner for manager comms? I can draft the manager email + TL;DR pack.

Tess (People Ops): Assign to Sophie. Devin — please confirm payroll readiness by Friday. Jamal — share localized comp mapping tomorrow. I'll update the handbook prod copy and trigger the HR-bot weekly digest.

Devin (Payroll): Will confirm by Friday.

Jamal (Comp): Mapping scheduled for tomorrow, will paste into this thread.

hr-bot: Noted — reminders scheduled. :white_check_mark:
